findings.detail: B02's normalized position key collapses distinct source instruments and tranches, including different investment types and acquisition dates, into duplicate keys.

rationale: Raw SOI rows 8-11 in table 9 show four separate Alert SRC Newco positions, distinguished by investment type and, for the two delayed-draw loans, acquisition date (12/11/2024 versus 9/19/2025), with separate par, cost, and fair value amounts. The B02 example therefore results from an under-specified normalized key rather than duplicated source positions. Source instrument terms are the decisive identity anchor; monetary aggregate anchors are not probative for this duplicate-key rule.
